master.definition_en: A cardiac rhythm disease characterized by prolongation of the corrected QT (QTc) interval on the surface electrocardiogram, associated with precipitation of torsade de pointes (TdP), a polymorphic ventricular tachycardia that may cause sudden death. It is characterized by episodes of fainting (syncope) and varying degree of ventricular arrhythmia. It may be congenital or, more frequently, acquired. The inherited forms are caused by mutation of genes encoding cardiac ion channel proteins.
synonyms_en: ventricular arrhythmia associated with long QT syndrome

curated.category: 遗传性心脏离子通道病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 1) 心脏细胞膜钾/钠离子通道基因突变（最常见KCNQ1、KCNH2、SCN5A）导致心肌复极充电时间异常延长（心电图QTc间期延长），极易诱发特征性的“尖端扭转型室性心动过速（TdP）”; 2) 患者常在青少年或青壮年时期因游泳、剧烈运动（LQT1型）、突然被闹钟/电话铃声惊吓（LQT2型）或夜间睡眠（LQT3型）突发晕厥、抽搐，常被误诊为“癫痫”，实则数分钟内可因蜕变为室颤而猝死; 3) 未经治疗的有症状患者10年累计猝死风险极高。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 属于可高度防可控的遗传性猝死病：严格避免致敏药物与特定诱因、足量长期服用普萘洛尔或纳多洛尔等非选择性β受体阻滞剂，以及对高危者联合左心交感神经切除术或植入ICD，可使绝大多数患者正常生活并显著降低猝死事件。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO GHE未单列遗传性离子通道病死因；研究显示在40岁以下心源性猝死（尤其是尸检阴性猝死）中，LQTS是占比最高的可识别遗传性病因之一

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国尚无全国性单列死亡登记；国内儿科及成人心律失常中心数据显示，未确诊被误诊为癫痫或迷走性晕厥是导致青壮年首发猝死的主要原因
annual_deaths_china.source: 中华医学会心电生理和起搏分会遗传性心律失常共识

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 新生儿及一般人群患病率约 1 / 2,000 – 1 / 2,500（Orphanet ORPHA:768）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 按全球人群发病率推算国内潜在携带者逾数十万人，但临床实际确诊率仍明显偏低

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 突发晕厥抽搐超过1分钟不醒或无呼吸脉搏，立即启动心肺复苏并拨打120及使用AED; 2) 院内一旦心电图证实为尖端扭转型室速（TdP），立即静脉推注硫酸镁（2g缓慢静注，核心急救药，即使血镁正常也有效）并积极补钾至4.5 mmol/L以上; 3) 立即停用所有可延长QT间期的药物；若因心动过缓诱发TdP，可使用异丙肾上腺素或临时起搏器适当提高基础心率（切忌常规使用胺碘酮等III类抗心律失常药，否则会进一步延长QT加重室速）。

non_drug_therapies_zh: 家系级联筛查与基因检测：先证者所有一级亲属（父母、子女、兄弟姐妹）必须行12导联心电图及致病基因（KCNQ1/KCNH2/SCN5A等）检测，检出隐匿携带者同样需预防性用药
终生严禁使用延长QT间期药物（随时核对CredibleMeds禁用清单，如部分大环内酯类抗生素、氟喹诺酮类、抗精神病药、昂丹司琼等）
高危患者（反复晕厥、心脏骤停幸存者或药物不耐受）行左心交感神经切除术（LCSD）或植入ICD
生活方式管控：LQT1型严禁无保护游泳与竞技体育；LQT2型卧室移除高分贝闹钟；发烧腹泻时及时补钾补镁并退热

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 2023–2024年长QT综合征迎来源头基因矫正突破：1) 梅奥诊所团队在2024年发表临床前重磅成果，利用AAV9递送的“抑制-替换（Suppression-Replacement, SupRep）”双功能基因疗法，在LQT1转基因兔模型中成功沉默突变KCNQ1并表达正常蛋白，使延长的QT间期恢复正常; 2) 针对KCNH2热点突变的引导编辑（Prime Editing）在患者诱导多能干细胞心肌细胞中实现精准修复; 3) 口服SGK1小分子抑制剂于2024年底获FDA孤儿药资格，旨在直接缩短异常延长的动作电位。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 临床大量“基因型阳性但静息心电图QTc正常”的隐匿携带者易被漏诊，亟需AI心电图微伏T波交替识别算法; 2) 国际金标准药物纳多洛尔在国内稳定供应不足; 3) 尚未有基因治疗或精准小分子药物进入人体注册临床阶段。

master.definition_en: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH, formerly known as nonalcoholic steatohepatitis or NASH) is a type of fatty liver disease. It often develops due to a metabolic disorder, such as obesity or diabetes, resulting in a toxic buildup of fat in the liver. It is the most severe form of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD, formerly known as nonalcoholic fatty liver disease or NAFLD).

curated.name_zh: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝炎
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 早期多无明显症状，但持续肝细胞炎症与纤维化可在数年至十余年间悄然进展为肝硬化、肝衰竭甚至肝细胞癌（HCC），同时显著增加心脑血管死亡风险。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 减重7%–10%及以上联合代谢管理可显著逆转肝脂肪变与早期纤维化；2024–2025年首个肝脏靶向药Resmetirom及Semaglutide已在国际获批用于伴中重度纤维化（F2–F3）MASH，打破长期无特效药僵局。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: MASH是全球肝硬化与肝癌增长最快的病因之一，但国际死因统计多归入“慢性肝病与肝硬化”或“肝癌”大类，未单列独立全球年度死亡人数。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国死因监测未单列MASH独立死亡数；随着病毒性肝炎控制，代谢相关脂肪性肝病已成为中国肝癌与肝硬化日益重要的推手。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球成人MASLD患病率约30%（约16.6亿人），其中MASH全球成人患病率估计为3%–6%。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国成人MASLD患病率约29%–30%（患者规模超3亿人），其中相当比例存在隐匿性MASH与进展期肝纤维化风险，肥胖及2型糖尿病人群中MASH比例极高。

non_drug_therapies_zh: 核心基石：通过地中海饮食控制总热量（每日减少500–1000 kcal）结合每周≥150分钟中等强度有氧+抗阻运动，实现减重7%–10%以上
严格戒酒（即使少量饮酒也会加速MASH纤维化进展），严格控制血糖、血压及血脂
每6–12个月采用FIB-4评分及肝脏瞬时弹性成像（FibroScan）无创监测肝纤维化，进展至肝硬化者每6个月筛查甲胎蛋白与超声防肝癌
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 生活方式管理与常规护肝/基础代谢用药年花费约1,000–4,000元；若自费使用GLP-1受体激动剂或未来引进创新MASH靶向药，年费用可达10,000–30,000+元。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 2024年3月FDA加速批准THR-β激动剂Resmetirom（MAESTRO-NASH III期试验显示26%–30%患者实现MASH消退且纤维化不恶化）；2) 司美格鲁肽2.4 mg在ESSENCE III期试验（2024–2025）中实现62.9% MASH消退（对照组34.3%）；3) FGF21类似物（Efruxifermin、Pegozafermin）与GLP-1/GIP/GCG多靶点激动剂处于III期临床。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 已进展为MASH相关肝硬化（F4期）的患者尚无获批可逆转纤维化的特效药物; 2) 临床诊断金标准仍依赖有创肝穿刺活检，无创血液标志物与影像学精准分层普及不足; 3) 新型靶向药在中国大陆的可及性与长期用药经济负担仍待解决。

master.definition_en: Acute myeloid leukemia and myelodysplastic syndromes related to topoisomerase type 2 inhibitor represent a subgroup of therapy-related myeloid neoplasms (t-MN), associated with treatment of an unrelated neoplastic disease with cytotoxic agents, like etoposid, doxorubicin, daunorubicin and others. The neoplastic cells often show rearrangements involving the mixed lineage leukemia gene at 11q23. This subgroup of t-MN is typically associated with overt leukemia, without preceding myelodysplastic syndrome, developing 2-3 years after exposure, presenting with non-specific symptoms related to ineffective hematopoesis (fatigue, bleeding and bruising, recurrent infections, bone pain) and/or extramedullary site involvement.

mondo_categories: therapy related acute myeloid leukemia and myelodysplastic syndrome

master.name_en: rapid-onset childhood obesity-hypothalamic dysfunction-hypoventilation-autonomic dysregulation syndrome
master.definition_en: A very rare disorder that appears after the first year and a half of life in previously healthy children. It is characterized by rapid-onset weight gain, hypothalamic dysfunction, breathing abnormalities, and autonomic system dysregulation. The hypothalamic dysfunction manifestations include inability to maintain normal water balance, high prolactin levels, low thyroid, low cortisol, and early or late puberty. The breathing abnormalities include sleep apnea and alveolar hypoventilation, requiring ventilation support. The autonomic system dysregulation includes eye abnormalities, intestinal abnormalities, temperature dysregulation, and low heart rhythm. This disorder requires early recognition because it may lead to cardiorespiratory arrest. Up to 40% of the patients develop tumors of neural crest origin.

master.definition_en: A platelet type bleeding disorder characterized by lifelong mucocutaneous bleeding, markedly impaired platelet aggregation, and absent or severely reduced clot retraction due to failure of the αIIbβ3 integrin complex to bind fibrinogen. Platelets appear normal in number and morphology, but aggregation responses to physiologic agonists (including ADP, collagen, epinephrine, and thrombin) are severely decreased or absent, while ristocetin‑induced agglutination remains normal. Biallelic loss‑of‑function ITGA2B variants reduce or abolish surface expression of the αIIbβ3 receptor, preventing fibrinogen‑mediated platelet bridging and producing the classic Glanzmann thrombasthenia phenotype.
